key_files.insights: Comprehensive session log documenting discovery of 79 child DocTypes across 7 apps with 130+ numeric fields cataloged in structured table format
6-phase implementation plan with 11 subtasks; 5 parallel document phases + 1 cross-document QA phase
Detailed inventory of 203+ DocTypes across 7 tradehub apps with focus on 88 child tables

file_insights.codebase_coverage: 7 apps (tradehub_commerce, tradehub_seller, tradehub_catalog, tradehub_core, tradehub_compliance, tradehub_logistics, tradehub_marketing)

patterns_discovered.description: Both order.js (client) and order.py (server) implement calculate_totals() — canonical pattern for all calculation fields
patterns_discovered.impact: High — must maintain consistency across both layers for discount_amount, tax_amount, line_total, commission_amount

patterns_discovered.description: Discount_amount, tax_amount, line_total, commission_amount marked as read_only=1; must be computed server-side
patterns_discovered.impact: High — prevents user tampering; requires strict validation logic

patterns_discovered.description: 50+ fetch_from instances linking City→District→Neighborhood; requires cascading updates when parent changes
patterns_discovered.impact: Medium — affects calculation of shipping rates, tax zones, pricing tiers

patterns_discovered.description: Every DocType includes tenant field; System Manager bypasses isolation
patterns_discovered.impact: High — calculations must respect tenant boundaries; cross-tenant data leakage risk

patterns_discovered.description: 73 JSON fields total (50 explicit + 23 Code+JSON); 19 candidates for migration to relational structure
patterns_discovered.impact: Medium — JSON storage limits query efficiency; migration needed for advanced filtering

patterns_discovered.description: Float fields use mixed precision: most 3 decimal places, some 2; Cart Line has discount_value with precision=2
patterns_discovered.impact: Medium — rounding errors compound in multi-field calculations

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Multiple child table variants for same parent
gotchas_discovered.description: Cart has both 'items' (Cart Line) and alternative 'items' (Cart Item) child structures; must handle both in calculation logic
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Document both child structures explicitly; test both paths

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Calculation order matters for cascading discounts
gotchas_discovered.description: Order Item has discount_percentage → discount_amount → final amount; if applied out-of-order, creates rounding errors
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Define strict calculation order in specification; unit test all permutations

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Tenant isolation bypasses for System Manager
gotchas_discovered.description: System Manager can view/edit cross-tenant data; if calculation logic doesn't verify tenant on save, data corruption possible
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Add explicit tenant checks in all calculation validation functions

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Missing precision specification in some Currency fields
gotchas_discovered.description: RFQ Quote Item total_price is Currency but has no precision attribute; may default to database column precision (unpredictable)
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Standardize all Currency fields to explicit precision; add schema validation

gotchas_discovered.description: 23 fields combine Code type with JSON data; cannot simply migrate to relational without parsing embedded code
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Phase migration: Stage 1 identify & document all Code+JSON; Stage 2 extract & normalize

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Sub Order Item has compare_at_price but no comparison logic identified
gotchas_discovered.description: Field exists but discount calculation logic may not use it; inconsistency with Marketplace Order Item
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify all discount logic references compare_at_price; align both DocTypes

approach_outcome.methodology: Systematic codebase scanning + JSON schema analysis + structured cataloging
deliverables: Detailed numeric field catalog (130+ fields) with metadata
approach_outcome.depth_achieved: 203+ DocTypes analyzed; 50+ fetch_from instances traced; 73 JSON fields identified; 19 migration candidates flagged
approach_outcome.time_efficiency: Deep investigation completed; parallelization possible (2.5x speedup with 3 workers estimated)
quality_indicators: Structured table format for all 22 high-priority child DocTypes
Consistent metadata capture (fieldname, fieldtype, options, reqd, read_only, default, precision)
Risk level assessed as 'trivial' (documentation only, no code changes)

recommendations.recommendation: Adopt dual-layer calculation pattern (order.js + order.py) as canonical across all child table calculations; document mandatory sync points
recommendations.rationale: Pattern already exists in 50+ instances; standardizing prevents divergence bugs

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit tenant field validation in all numeric calculation functions; prevent System Manager bypass in calculation logic
recommendations.rationale: Tenant isolation is foundational; calculations must not leak cross-tenant data

recommendations.recommendation: Standardize all Float fields to precision=3; standardize all Currency fields to decimal(15,2); document rounding rules for each calculation
recommendations.rationale: Mixed precision creates compound rounding errors in cascading discounts; standard precision simplifies QA

recommendations.recommendation: Define explicit calculation order in specification: (1) apply discounts, (2) apply taxes, (3) apply commissions, (4) sum totals; unit test all permutations
recommendations.rationale: Order matters for accuracy; Order Item discounts must be applied before tax calculation

recommendations.recommendation: Audit all Currency & Float fields for missing precision attributes; add schema validation to flag unprecified fields on import/creation
recommendations.rationale: RFQ Quote Item total_price lacks precision; unpredictable database behavior results

recommendations.recommendation: Create specification document for each of 5 phases (108.md, 112.md, 124.md, 128.md, 134.md) with worked examples for all calculation patterns
recommendations.rationale: Phase 6 (cross-document QA) depends on complete specifications; worked examples reduce implementation errors

recommendations.recommendation: Build test fixtures for all 22 high-priority child DocTypes with edge cases: zero quantities, negative discounts, tax overrides, tenant boundaries
recommendations.rationale: Prevent regressions; fixtures reduce time for Phase 6 QA validation

recommendations.recommendation: Phase migration of 19 JSON field candidates: (1) extract & normalize, (2) map to relational schema, (3) create data migration script, (4) validate equivalence
recommendations.rationale: 19 candidates identified; migration enables advanced filtering and reporting

recommendations.recommendation: Execute phases 1–5 in parallel with 3 workers; phase 6 sequential after all are complete; estimated 2.5x speedup vs sequential
recommendations.rationale: All document phases are independent; resource-limited environment justifies 3-worker cap
